name: novembre-bleu-arosoft
description: Novembre Bleu 2026 - film de sensibilisation au cancer de la prostate (Côte d'Ivoire) - Remotion

scripts.preview:15s: npm run media && remotion render NovembreBleu-Preview15s out/preview-S01-S03-15s.mp4
scripts.render:vertical: npm run media && remotion render NovembreBleu-Vertical out/novembre-bleu-1080x1920-raw.mp4 && bash scripts/master.sh out/novembre-bleu-1080x1920-raw.mp4 out/novembre-bleu-1080x1920.mp4
scripts.render:horizontal: npm run media && remotion render NovembreBleu-Horizontal out/novembre-bleu-1920x1080-raw.mp4 && bash scripts/master.sh out/novembre-bleu-1920x1080-raw.mp4 out/novembre-bleu-1920x1080.mp4
scripts.render:all: npm run render:vertical && npm run render:horizontal
scripts.music: npm run timeline && python3 -I scripts/generate-music.py scripts/timeline.json public/assets/audio
